purpose: Identify opportunities with at least two active applications.
expected: Exact result: 1 | 2; 10 | 3; 11 | 2.
sql: SELECT opportunity_id, COUNT(*) AS active_applications FROM application WHERE status IN ('pending','accepted') GROUP BY opportunity_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY opportunity_id;
